fact: The nationally representative EHCVM 2021/22 household survey (LSMS), fielded Nov 2021-Aug 2022 by INE, has its data and documentation published in the World Bank Microdata Library.
title: Inquérito Harmonizado sobre as Condiçöes de vide dos Agreagados Familiares, 2021-2022
publisher: World Bank Microdata Library / Instituto Nacional de Estatística (INE)
